findings: All4 strap/reset snapshots precede common mutation; inner starts only after all40 common values verified. Reverse order is TOP address+own semaphore, reset/mux/data/direction, common40, then enclosing power probe.

Original cold ownership proof/AP prerequisites remain; first13 shared cold predicates retained during command. Excluding SPI busy predicate is necessary for own in-flight operation; helper independently polls TOP busybit5.

Dirty trigger write/barrier/guard/completion uncertainty immediately retains semaphore, straps/reset and common40. Outer result clean0 reaches persistent dirty latch/panic, nw_restore refusal and input_prepare_return -1/WFE chain. No trigger replay.

Partial writes mark touched before write; restored bits require full readback including unchanged unowned bits. Unknown valid ID cleans digital state and reports error rather than selecting an analog table.
Sem acquire is bounded1000 attempts; TOP poll bounded100 reads/phase with99 possible50us gaps. Ordered ni_wr includes dmb oshst and dsb osh.
Default common-off returns before added maps/MMIO/logs; adie-off preserves ordinary common behavior. No active integration performed.
limitations: Clean means completed command plus ordered own-semaphore release and verified digital/address restoration. It does not restore RD/status side effects or undo analog read. Release has no source-established nondestructive acknowledgement; README explicitly states this.

Native MMIO has no recoverable errno or bus-transaction timeout. Bounded loops do not make an unreturned MMIO access bounded. 91/92 write fault tests exclude native release write recoverable-error channel; pure ID tests cover callback release failures.

Host fault tests cannot prove silicon register stability, XO response, simultaneous external agents, or actual runtime cost. Gate next hardware use on common-stage hardware evidence and separately authorized active TOPSPI read.
